related_questions.snippet: Pay for the CEO of Fayetteville-based Cape Fear Valley Health System rose by 158% from 2011 to 2019, a report on hospital executive pay issued last week by the state treasurer says. CEO Mike Nagowski's pay went from about $707,000 in 2011 to $1.825 million in 2019, the report says.

related_questions.question: What level of trauma is Cape Fear Valley Medical Center?

text_blocks.snippet: Cape Fear Valley Medical Center is a designated Level III Trauma Center. This means it provides prompt assessment, resuscitation, surgery, and intensive care for patients with moderate to severe traumatic injuries. It is also the busiest emergency department in North Carolina and one of the top 13 busiest in the nation, according to the North Carolina Department of Health and Human Services.
